hypothesis: Delivery failure must not revoke a paid report; scoped configuration can remain safely disabled until an owner-controlled receipt test.

controls: Configured disabled sender makes zero provider calls and no storage changes
Paid download survives HTTP 429, HTTP 503, thrown timeout, invalid JSON, missing receipt
Immediate retries are suppressed; later retry preserves exact payload, private capability and idempotency key
Request, unpaid denial, reviewed summary, signed payment and report link sequence

additionalCheck: Existing notification regression script passed; git diff --check passed

ownerTest.state: awaiting owner-controlled recipient and explicit isolated-send agreement
ownerTest.subject: Audit GEO — one-time delivery verification
ownerTest.text: This is the single delivery verification email you requested for the Audit GEO pilot. No payment has been taken, no audit has been purchased, and customer notifications remain disabled. Please confirm receipt in the owner console, including whether this arrived in your inbox or spam folder.
procedure: After genuine owner answer, send exactly one transactional test using connected Resend, from Audit GEO <audits@vutler.com>; keep Sites RESEND_EMAILS_ENABLED=false.
Record non-secret provider message ID and acceptance; do not automatically resend ambiguous outcomes.
Ask owner to confirm actual inbox/spam receipt; provider accepted/delivered status is separate.
A native connector send proves provider/sender path, not use of the Sites runtime credential; production payment-to-email proof remains separately required.

supervisorVerification.scope: Local mocked controls independently rerun; no production send or inbox proof
